description: A signal officer must publish the next-day communications configuration for command coordination, logistics operations, clinic support, and airfield services, assigning channels, equipment, power settings, operating windows, and required technical controls.

shared_context.S1: The unit has channels C1, C2, C3, and C4 available for next-day routine coordination.
shared_context.S2: Repeater R1 covers the command area, R2 covers the clinic area, and R3 covers the logistics yard.
shared_context.S3: The signal officer publishes the binding communications configuration, and the standard plan uses C1 for command, C2 for logistics, C3 for clinic support, and C4 for airfield services.
shared_context.S4: The signal shop can configure channels and power settings before 1800 today.
shared_context.S5: At the routine daily communications planning huddle, the operations, logistics, maintenance, and airfield representatives each report current requirements before the configuration is published.

PF1.text: The battalion coordination directive confirmed this morning requires the command net to use C2 from 0600 to 1000 tomorrow; Capt. Mercer received the directive after the morning briefing, and the communications slide has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: SFC Alvarez confirmed from the issued-battery ledger that only R3 has enough battery capacity to support the logistics yard tomorrow, and R3 must be configured at low power from 0700 to 1100; the ledger reconciliation is still awaiting posting to the signal work queue.

PF3.text: WO1 Patel's maintenance test found that R1 must be taken offline for firmware validation from 1200 to 1400 tomorrow, so clinic support during that period must use R2; the test result remains on the technician worksheet pending entry into the network status board.

PF4.text: 1LT Brooks confirmed that airfield calibration activity will make C4 unavailable at the airfield tomorrow, so airfield services must use C3 at 25 watts and complete an interference check before 0800; the airfield notice was signed after the last signal update and has not been added to the configuration packet.

interaction_config.settle_guidance: After all four representatives have reported and no new objection has been raised in the immediately preceding round, the signal officer should publish the settlement rather than request another confirmation. Use exact scalar values in decision fields: command_channel must be 'C2', logistics_power must be 'low', clinic_repeater must be 'R2', and interference_check_deadline should be '0800' or 'before 0800'. Set r1_firmware_validation_required and battery_configuration_required to true.

formatting_guidance.A5: Return valid JSON with exactly one quoted type value, such as {"type":"reveal","fact_id":"PF4","text":"..."}.

settlement_schema.instructions: Use exact scalar values. command_channel is the primary command channel during the required window; command_revert_channel is separate. logistics_power must be exactly 'low'; logistics_window is separate. clinic_repeater is the required fallback repeater during the outage; clinic_normal_repeater is separate. Set each control field to a boolean. interference_check_deadline may be '0800' or 'before 0800'.

acceptance_conditions: The command net must use C2 during 0600-1000, with C1 as the separate post-window command channel.
The logistics yard must use R3 at low power from 0700-1100.
Clinic support must use R2 from 1200-1400 while R1 is offline.
Airfield services must use C3 at 25 watts.
An interference check must be required before 0800.
Firmware validation of R1 must be required from 1200-1400.
The R3 battery configuration control must be required.
The command coordination directive must be cited in the justification.

decisive_facts.why: The directive changes the command channel from standard C1 to exactly C2 and fixes the command window at exactly 0600-1000.
The battery ledger changes the logistics repeater to exactly R3, fixes power at exactly low from 0700-1100, and requires battery_configuration_required to be true.
The maintenance test changes clinic support to exactly R2 from 1200-1400 and requires r1_firmware_validation_required to be true for exactly that window.
The airfield notice changes airfield services to exactly C3 at exactly 25 watts and requires the interference check deadline to be recorded as 0800 or before 0800.
